Definition: from G4862 and G305; to ascend in company with:--come up with.
BiblicalUsage: Mark says many women who had followed Jesus in Galilee and ministered to Him also came up with Him to Jerusalem, and Paul says the risen Jesus was seen many days by those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They went up with Him to the city where He would die, and they were His witnesses because they had gone the road with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that witnesses are made on the road, not only at the destination, and I hold that going up with Jesus is the way to see Him risen.
